Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Two long-term friends just had a falling out, a person with autism and a sister of mine. I went to talk to each of them about it. The person with autism wasn't willing to talk about it at all and just wanted me to leave, while the sister of mine mentioned being really sad because they liked having such a close connection with someone. Who talked about their emotions?
A. The person with autism
B. The sister 
C. Cannot be determined
